name: Lumi
tagline: Finds tech meetups in your city worth leaving the house for
description: Searches Luma for technology and tech-adjacent gatherings near you and surfaces the ones where you are likely to meet people who build things. Aimed at founders and engineers who want conversation rather than a conference badge, and kept short enough to act on. Your city and interests decide the list.
author: logesh45
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
